EmailTemplate.name: MAQL SLA EXPIRED
EmailTemplate.subject: Please accept or reject your pending MAQL lead
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.OwnerFirstName},
The lead {!Lead.Name} from {!Lead.Company} assigned to you with a lead stage of MAQL, and the Lead Status has not been set to “Accepted” or “Rejected” within the SLA time for a {!Lead.Core_Lead_Priority__c} priority lead Click here to visit this lead record in SFDC
As a reminder, the following SLA is expected for any MAQL lead assigned to you:
(<Lead Priority> if Hot): Lead Status must be set to “accepted” or “rejected” within 1 business day (<Lead Priority> if Warm): Lead Status must be set to “accepted” or “rejected” within 2 business days (<Lead Priority> if Cold): Lead Status must be set to “accepted” or “rejected” within 4 business days Please disposition your lead by updating the Lead Status as soon as possible. Any leads not updated will be collected and a list of stagnant leads along with lead owners will be sent to your team lead weekly. Thank you.
